data.one_liner: A Dart library for building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and clients.
data.what_it_does: Provides base classes and mixins to implement MCP servers and clients, exposing capabilities and utilities defined by the MCP spec. It supports communication over streams, including stdio, and handles initialization, capability negotiation, and RPC calls.
use_when: You need to build a local MCP server or client for a Dart application
You want to expose or consume MCP capabilities such as prompts, resources, or tools
You prefer a stream‑based, imperative API for RPC communication
avoid_when: You only need simple HTTP or WebSocket communication
You require authentication or push notifications
You need a fully featured AI client library with built‑in models
strengths: Built‑in support for MCP protocol versions and capability negotiation
Stream‑based API fits well with Dart async streams
Extensible mixins for server and client capabilities
Supports stdio transport out of the box
weaknesses: No code generation or declarative UI helpers
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import server.dart or client.dart, extend MCPServer/MCPClient, provide a StreamChannel for communication.
